title: Rusty Hogg's pawn shop
summary: The pawn shop is now a real store off the south corridor, run by Rusty Hogg, with guns for sale on the wall.
notes: Add a pawn shop room west of the south corridor with a GPS destination.
Add Rusty Hogg behind the pawn counter.
Sell the pistol, SMG, shotgun and AWP from the shop wall.
Move the Gun-O-Matic and its trash can into the pawn shop and shrink its sign to normal size.
Remove the free guns from the casino lobby counter.
